name: last30days-skill
description: AI agent skill that researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket, and the web - then synthesizes a grounded summary
one_liner: Tell it a person, company, or topic and it reads everything recent about it across Reddit, X, YouTube, and betting markets, then gives you a one-page briefing.
buyer: A sales rep or recruiter who needs a sharp, current briefing before a call with a prospect or candidate.
business_use_cases: A B2B sales rep runs it on a prospect company the night before a demo to walk in with current, specific talking points.
A journalist or newsletter writer uses it to quickly gather cross-platform sentiment on a breaking story.
A recruiter runs it on a candidate to surface recent public activity (talks, posts, projects) before an interview.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a 'pre-meeting briefing' service for sales teams: paste a company name, get a formatted one-pager delivered by email.
Build a Slack bot wrapper that runs this automatically before every calendar meeting, sold per-seat.

steal_this: Wrap this in a simple web form ("paste a name, get a briefing PDF") and sell it to local sales teams as a $20/month tool this weekend.
